queries.query: Where does Sam live?
queries.comment: Direct fact retrieval. Both systems should handle this trivially. (legacy q01)

queries.query: What is Maria's profession?
queries.comment: Direct fact retrieval. Control case. (legacy q02)

queries.query: When is Maria's birthday?
queries.comment: Direct fact retrieval. Tests if both can extract dates. (legacy q03)

queries.query: What climbing shoes did Sam order?
queries.comment: Direct fact retrieval. Recent memory. (legacy q04)

queries.query: In which city is the company that David works for headquartered?
queries.comment: Information packaged in a single memory (m14 mentions both David's employer and HQ city). Single-hop in practice. (legacy q05)

queries.query: What programming language does Sam's web scraper use?
queries.comment: Two memories needed: original Python decision and Rust rewrite. Tests temporal awareness. (legacy q06)

queries.query: What does Sam's mother do for a living, and where does she live?
queries.expected_answer: high school chemistry teacher in Boston
queries.comment: Two-hop chain: Sam → mother Maria → profession + city. Both systems should handle. (legacy q07)

queries.query: Who is the manager of the person whose brother works at Amazon?
queries.comment: 3-hop chain: Amazon → David → Sam (brother) → manager Marcus. HippoRAG's PPR propagates through arbitrary chains; A-Mem's 1-hop link traversal may miss this unless link generation correctly connected the relevant notes. (legacy q08)

queries.query: What is the profession of the partner of the engineer who has a brother in Seattle?
queries.comment: 3-hop chain: Seattle → David → brother Sam → partner Alex → graphic designer. Requires propagating through Sam's identity. (legacy q09)

queries.query: In which city was the person born who is married to the graphic designer's partner's brother?
queries.expected_answer: unknown / cannot determine (Maria's birth location is not in the facts)
queries.comment: Trick: deep multi-hop chain (graphic designer → Alex → partner Sam → brother David → ??) but the answer requires David's birth location which isn't in the memory store. Both systems should ideally abstain. Tests whether deep multi-hop also induces hallucination. (legacy q10)

queries.query: What outdoor activities does Sam enjoy?
queries.expected_answer: rock climbing (Yosemite, Joshua Tree, Berkeley Ironworks — though gym is indoor)
queries.comment: Requires conceptual categorization: 'outdoor activities' isn't a direct field in any memory. A-Mem's LLM-generated tags might tag climbing memories as 'outdoor recreation'; HippoRAG's KG nodes are entity-centric and wouldn't naturally surface 'outdoor' as a concept. (legacy q11)

queries.query: What Python libraries has Sam used?
queries.comment: Requires inferring that BeautifulSoup is a Python library — the memories don't say this explicitly. A-Mem's LLM-generated context (X) likely encodes this; HippoRAG's OpenIE wouldn't extract a (BeautifulSoup, is_a, Python library) triple. (legacy q12)

queries.query: What hobbies has Sam been less active in lately?
queries.expected_answer: Spanish learning (slipped to once a week) and climbing (first session in two weeks before m38)
queries.comment: Requires recognising 'less active' as a concept connecting two unrelated facts about reduced frequency. A-Mem's LLM-determined links might cluster these as 'declining engagement'; HippoRAG won't naturally. (legacy q13)

queries.query: Where does Sam currently work?
queries.comment: Sam transitioned TechCorp → StartupCo in Week 6-7. HippoRAG retains both as equal facts in the KG. A-Mem's memory evolution should update the earlier 'works at TechCorp' notes when the StartupCo memories arrived — though this depends on the LLM prompt quality during evolution. (legacy q14)

queries.query: Who is Sam's current manager?
queries.comment: Same issue as q14. HippoRAG holds both Jennifer (TechCorp) and Marcus (StartupCo) as Sam's managers. Tests whether either system prefers the more recent assertion. (legacy q15)

queries.query: What language is Sam's climbing scraper currently written in?
queries.comment: Sam migrated the scraper Python → Rust in Week 7. Tests temporal precedence of contradicting facts about the same project. (legacy q16)

queries.query: Who are all the people Sam has mentioned in conversations?
queries.expected_answer: Alex (partner), Jennifer (old manager), Maria (mother), David (brother), Marcus (new manager)
queries.comment: Aggregating across many memories. HippoRAG's PPR over the KG naturally surfaces all entities linked to Sam. A-Mem's top-k retrieval may miss entities that share little semantic similarity to the query. (legacy q17)

queries.query: What different programming languages and libraries has Sam used or learned?
queries.comment: Cross-passage aggregation. Multiple memories mention different technologies; need to surface them all. (legacy q18)

queries.query: What places does Sam have travel or residence connections to?
queries.expected_answer: Oakland (lives), San Francisco (work), Boston (mother + planned trip), Seattle (brother), Yosemite (climbed), Joshua Tree (planned trip), Mexico (Spanish learning motivation)
queries.comment: Geographic aggregation across many disparate memories. HippoRAG's KG should have a 'location' cluster; A-Mem may miss some via top-k retrieval. (legacy q19)

queries.query: What is Sam's favorite food?
queries.comment: Never mentioned in any memory. Both systems should abstain rather than hallucinate. (legacy q20)

queries.query: Does Sam have any pets?
queries.comment: Never mentioned. Tests whether systems hallucinate pet ownership from related context (e.g., living with a partner). (legacy q21)

queries.query: What is Sam's salary at StartupCo?
queries.comment: Salary detail never specified. Tests against the failure mode of confabulating plausible numbers. (legacy q22)
